arguments.text: Milestone complete: Stage 3 source comparison is implemented in work.py and report.json matches current requests, policy, and evidence. Local checks passed for sorted missing conditions, no evidence, verification filtering, exact required-condition matching including absent-vs-zero calibration, eligible-only supersession, canonical JSON agreement, false-vs-zero conflict, source-count neutrality, Boolean false unsupported status, exact output fields, and input immutability. Remaining limits: malformed/non-JSON inputs, missing or non-string source IDs, cyclic values, and non-finite numbers are outside tested conditions; executable handoff status rules are scoped to observed fixtures because the model expression language cannot generically encode canonical JSON comparison plus eligible-only supersession.
